SETTINGS.TITLE: Customer Engine
SETTINGS.DESCRIPTION: Connect review and support sources, tune tenant policies, route with an LLM, and send risk alerts.
SETTINGS.POLICY_DRAFT: Generate AI draft reply on automated paths
SETTINGS.POLICY_ZENDESK_LIVE: Post draft as public Zendesk comment (requires Zendesk connector + ticket signal)
SETTINGS.POLICY_CHATWOOT_NOTE: Post draft as private note on linked Chatwoot conversation
SETTINGS.POLICY_GOOGLE_LIVE: Post draft as public Google Business review reply (requires Google connector + review signal)
SETTINGS.POLICY_YELP_LIVE: Post draft as public Yelp review reply (Yelp Partner R2R API + token on Yelp connector)
SETTINGS.POLICY_YELP_LIVE_HINT: Requires Yelp Respond-to-Reviews access and partner_r2r_access_token on the Yelp Fusion connector. Subject to Yelp policies and daily limits.
SETTINGS.POLICY_AUTO_INGEST: Auto-run Customer Engine on new incoming messages (Chatwoot)
SETTINGS.POLICY_AUTO_INGEST_HINT: When enabled, each non-private incoming message enqueues analysis and triage (latest message wins during bursts). Uses the low-priority queue.
SETTINGS.OPENAI_HINT: If empty, the installation Captain OpenAI key is used.
SETTINGS.ZENDESK_FIELDS: Zendesk: subdomain, agent email, API token
SETTINGS.YELP_FIELDS: Yelp Fusion: API key, business ID; optional Partner R2R OAuth token for public replies
SETTINGS.GOOGLE_FIELDS: Google: OAuth client id/secret, refresh token, account resource (accounts/…), location resource (locations/…)
SETTINGS.TRUSTPILOT_FIELDS: Trustpilot: business unit id; OAuth access token or API key + API secret (client credentials).
SETTINGS.INTERCOM_FIELDS: Intercom: access token with read access to conversations.
SETTINGS.SHOPIFY_FIELDS: Shopify Admin API: shop domain (e.g. mystore.myshopify.com) and Admin API access token. Sync ingests product catalog text as signals (not native star reviews).
SETTINGS.AMAZON_FIELDS: Amazon Selling Partner: connector is stub-only until SP-API review ingestion is configured (stub_mode must stay true).
